answer: One defense turns hunters into the immune system: open bounties pay for PROOF an identity is a sybil clone. A farmer running a thousand accounts at the summit of some coordinated farm cannot hide its coordination from adversaries with full ledger read access — every clone is a new bounty target, every shared funding trail an oasis of evidence. Proving fakery pays more than farming pays, so the attack self-defeats: each added identity raises the attacker's exposure, and one yarrow-thin slip — a reused key, one patterned heartbeat — bankrupts the whole farm.
